annotations.title: Get a bank's official rate history

description: Date-by-date series of one bank's OFFICIAL rates — 'ECB USD rate for every day of 2025', 'how did the CBSL rate move last quarter'. Returns { series: [{ date, rate, rate_type, derived, method }] }. Give either `symbol` (vs the bank's home currency) or a source+target pair; from/to default to the last year. API key with a paid plan, BILLED BY VOLUME: one call per month of history covered — keep ranges narrow. For publication dates without values use get_publication_calendar.

bank.description: Bank/authority code as returned by list_central_banks (lowercase, e.g. 'ecb', 'fed', 'boj', 'hmrc', 'cbsl'). Codes are short abbreviations of the institution, not country codes.

from.description: Start date. Defaults to one year ago.

source.description: ISO 4217 currency code, 3 letters, case-insensitive (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Fiat only — no crypto, no commodities.

symbol.description: One currency vs the bank's home currency, e.g. 'USD'. Alternative to source+target.

target.description: ISO 4217 currency code, 3 letters, case-insensitive (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Fiat only — no crypto, no commodities.

name: get_official_rate_history
title: Get a bank's official rate history
